preconditions.description: The number of students n must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each student p_i must be a valid student number between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers, one for each student.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output value must be a valid student number between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == find_second_hole(i + 1, p) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output value for each student a must be the student who receives the second hole in the badge.
